content: निवस् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To live, dwell, stay; आहो निवत्स्यति समं हरिणाङ्गनाभिः <ls>Ś. 1. 26</ls>; निवसिष्यसि मय्येव <ls>Bg. 12. 8</ls>. .²2 To be, exist, निवसन्नन्तर्दारुणि लङ्घ्यो वह्निर्न तु ज्वलितः <ls>Pt. 1. 31</ls>. .²3 To occupy, settle in, take possession of. .²4 To sojourn, pass the night. .²5 To cohabit; <ls>Mb. 9</ls>. --II. €2 <ab>Ā.</ab> .²1 To dress, wear or put on clothes. .²2 To change oneʼs clothes. .²3 To gird round (as a sword).
